audit.replacement_rule: Match checkpoint identity, file, status, assertion count and failure messages; or byte-identical retained copy. Remove superseded reports only after current findings are consolidated.
audit.protected_rule: Preserve registered source snapshots, provenance manifests, original user input, frozen intake, complete outcomes, unique failures, inspected assertions and final bindings.
audit.historical_reference_rule: Retained raw inventories and frozen sources keep their original bytes. Resolve retired locators with this record and base_revision.
audit.knowledge_navigation_scope: Only Markdown targets changed in two knowledge records. Intent, criteria, source entries, review state and publication status remain unchanged.

removed.reason: Unreferenced or historical duplicate validation output; retained byte-identical copy and Git history.
removed.recovery_limit: The earlier identical copy was retired in this full cleanup. Recover the original bytes at prior_git_revision.
